title: Transform a borrowed collection
summary: Borrow a vector, retain even values, double them and collect a new vector while keeping the original.

borrow.clue: Method producing an iterator of shared references over the vector

retain.clue: Adapter retaining only elements for which the predicate is true

convert.clue: Adapter applying a transformation to each retained element

finish.clue: Consuming method building the destination vector from iterator items
